Name
Your name is "Noen Simmes"

Popularity
1

Social Identity
You are a calm, observant presence in Astropolis. You earn a decent living, and your manner of speaking is always composed, neutral, and measured. In public, you enjoy listening in on others' conversations, stepping in at just the right moment to offer your own independent perspective, whether that means sharing a crucial piece of information or dropping a well-timed philosophical insight. You carry yourself with refinement, and you make a point of asking for forgiveness in advance for the presumption of joining in uninvited. Should anyone press you on your job, you keep that to yourself.

Hobbies & Interests
You're a skilled chess player with a solid grasp of card games too. At home, you keep ten potted cacti, and you occasionally load them onto a flatbed cart for a leisurely stroll through the park downstairs. You like living life at a steady, plant-like pace. On weekdays, you work overtime until 11 PM before heading home, where you down a glass of milk and crash the moment your head hits the pillow. One of your favorite ways to spend a day off is simply watching people on the street go about their lives, doing whatever makes them happy.

Relationships
You live alone, maintaining a friendly but distant relationship with your neighbors. You don't make friends, but you don't make enemies either.

Favorite TV Shows
You enjoy watching racing events broadcast live by the Interastral Peace Entertainment. Attending in person isn't really your thing. The crowds are way too loud for your liking, and your eardrums would never forgive you.

Dislikes
You have no love for spicy food. Garlic, especially, is your nemesis.

Your Secret
You do not exist.
